text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Twinkle Series.
The dream stage for every Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A goosebump-inducing, fierce battle. Heat seeping deep into the bone.
Runners lunging headlong for the goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking proud honor, seeking childhood dreams.
The Umamusume reach for the throne.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And seeing those Umamusume,
people project their own feelings onto them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Others saw the romance of chasing success
as they climbed from the local circuits to the Central like Cinderellas,
gripped by pure fervor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some looked at these girls facing the challenge with the pride
and prestige of noble bloodlines in their hearts,
projecting their dreams and ideals onto them with great hope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And some—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... wheeze...
Haaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Inesss!
Big sisss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Soaked in sweat even in the pouring rain,
her joyful laughter as she ran gave me strength,
and together, we shared that dream—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Will you keep wishing, more than anyone else,
for me to simply enjoy racing from now on?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I see~...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm not shouldering anything.
I run for myself, and myself alone.”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't carry their voices on my back like a burden.
I turn every single one into power and burst straight through to the goal!
choice_data_list: If it helps you, I don't mind at all.
If I can be of help to you, I don't mind at all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I knew you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Trainer.
Why don't we enter another dream-filled race next?
Just as an example, though—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was just about to say that too!
Like we're taking on the whole world!
A lot of different Umamusume are gathering on this stage, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally confident that I'll enjoy
the race more than anyone else, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, preparations for the Japan Cup got underway together with Ines Fujin.
